title: Ordinary complex derivative of a scalar monomial
statement: For $c,z\in\mathbf C$ and $n\in\mathbf N$, the function $w\mapsto cw^n$ has ordinary complex derivative $c(nz^{n-1})$ at $z$. Here $n-1$ is truncated subtraction in $\mathbf N$, so the derivative is zero when $n=0$. Ordinary derivative means the limit of $(f(z+h)-f(z))/h$ as nonzero $h\in\mathbf C$ tends to zero, and absolute value is [def-weil-complex-absolute-value].
